userApproval.scope: one combined approval for the complete V2 spec and plan

evidence: Runtime SQLite is canonical; checkpoints are reconstructable cursors and every node reconciles runtime first.
Fenced intents plus fsynced wrapper launch receipts close duplicate-launch and stale-reconciler windows.
Task/project repair materialization, supersession epochs, replay-prefix hashes, and fresh verifier tree hashes are deterministic.
Targeted closure review found no unresolved major architecture gap.
The same-UID credential limitation is explicit and no credential-isolation claim remains.
Cold rollout and rollback are bound by absolute allowlists, exact smoke data, three-domain CAS, an exclusive lock, zero live children/DB handles, prepared images, and a resumable fsynced journal.
No unresolved blocking or major safety/rollback gap was found.
V2 is staged beside V1 until T7; all current V1 consumers are owned before the cutover deletion gate.
RunManifest, schema parity, capability, launch fencing, repair replay, multi-run scheduling, role-manifest chain, cutover inventory, hostile-worker, and rollout CAS tests have explicit owners.
The validated schedule contains ten tasks and only the disjoint T3/T4 writer wave is parallel.

resolvedFindings: Declared runtime.db the sole canonical state and checkpoints.db a disposable cursor cache with intent-first crash ordering.
Staged V2 contracts beside V1 and moved final V1 consumer/schema/migration deletion to T7.
Defined TaskRepairContractV2 and ProjectRepairContractV2 with explicit materialization, invalidation, closure, and replay semantics.
Added fenced wrapper launch receipts, exact-session crash rules, and stale-reconciler rejection.
Required fresh detached verifier, task reviewer, and combined reviewer worktrees with immutable input hashes.
Separated per-role skill bundle hashes under one aggregate immutable RunManifestV2.
Reframed host authentication as a trusted-host limitation rather than worker credential isolation.
Added complete code/SQLite/service rollout CAS, exact sidecar handling, rollback lock, prepared images, and resumable journal.
Defined durable multi-run FIFO scheduling, exact file/resource conflicts, cancellation, lease recovery, and the global five-child cap.
Added valid/invalid JSON Schema parity and canonical round-trip requirements.
remainingAcceptedLimitations: Host-native same-UID workers can read authentication required for provider access; V2 provides deterministic configuration, non-recording, redaction, and leak detection, not OS credential isolation.
The hard live gate depends on the configured relay and required models being available; unavailability leaves V2 unreleased.
